title: Uwell Crown D Replacement Pods - 2 Pack
description: Sleek and stylish, simple to use yet highly customisable, the new Uwell Crown D pod kit is a versatile and satisfying vape kit that’s ideal for RDTL and DTL vaping. This pack of two replacement Uwell Crown D pods are compatible with the Uwell Crown D pod kit only and feature a 2ml e-liquid capacity and a super-comfortable drip tip which detaches to reveal a leak-resistant refill port. The Uwell Crown D pod is compatible with Uwell’s PA mesh coils, available in a 0.3ohm resistance for smooth and airy DTL vaping ( we recommend High VG e-liquids ), and a 0.8ohm resistance for a more intense, RDTL/MTL sensation ( we recommend 50/50 and Nic Salt e-liquids .) Please Note: When filling your pod with e-liquid for the first time, allow the pod to sit for ten minutes before use. This will allow the e-liquid to better saturate the wicking material, a type of cotton, to prevent dry hits and ensure the best flavour and performance from your coil.
